listing.name: Teeworlds
listing.summary: Swing through 2D arenas, play local and online matches, and create your own maps.
listing.download_block_reason: Choose a download from the Teeworlds project or install the game through your package manager.

steps.title: Install the client
steps.instruction: On Windows, extract the publisher ZIP and open teeworlds.exe. On Linux, install Teeworlds through your package manager or unpack the publisher archive and launch teeworlds from its folder. The community Flathub package is available on Linux x64 and ARM64. The publisher’s Mac disk image contains an Intel client.

steps.title: Add the Windows client to Portcove
steps.instruction: After extracting the complete official Windows x64 ZIP, select teeworlds.exe and its containing folder. Keep the data folder and the accompanying files together. Leave launch options empty, review the details, and add the game. Choose Play separately. teeworlds_srv.exe is the dedicated server, not the client.

steps.title: Add the Linux client to Portcove
steps.instruction: Select the teeworlds client from your complete Linux x64 package and use its containing folder as the start folder. A distribution package normally installs it at /usr/games/teeworlds; install its data package and dependencies through the same package manager. Leave launch options empty. Update the installation through upstream or your package manager.

steps.title: Play and record a match
steps.instruction: The Teeworlds 0.7 client connects to Teeworlds 0.7 servers. In a match, press F1 and enter record followed by a demo name. Enter stoprecord to finish, then open the recording from Demos.

warnings: Before moving your setup, close the game and copy the data folder with settings07.cfg, demos, custom maps, and any skins you want to keep.

references.title: Find your data folder
references.instruction: The defaults are %APPDATA%/Teeworlds on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/Teeworlds on Mac, and ~/.local/share/teeworlds on Linux. On Linux, the game prefers an existing ~/.teeworlds folder or uses $XDG_DATA_HOME/teeworlds if XDG_DATA_HOME is set. For the Flathub installation, check ~/.var/app/com.teeworlds.Teeworlds/.teeworlds. If you changed storage.cfg, use its save location.

data_locations: Windows %APPDATA%/Teeworlds settings07.cfg, demos, maps and skins
the save location selected by storage.cfg, and any custom maps or skins kept with the installation

presentation.manual_preparation: Set up the official Teeworlds client and its complete data through upstream or your Linux package manager. Select teeworlds.exe on Windows x64 or the native teeworlds client on Linux x64, with its containing folder and no required launch options. Review the program and start folder, add the game, then choose Play. Keep updates, settings07.cfg, demos, maps, skins and any storage.cfg paths with the installation you maintain. Removing its Portcove registration preserves external files. Managed installation, update, backup, rollback and data deletion are not offered.
